name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from an edge for secondary tasks, details or navigation.
a11y: Focus is trapped while open and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape and the overlay close it.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides from. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction; `left` and `right` are fixed.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Shows a "Close" text button. Escape and the overlay always close it.
